show_hn.title: Show HN: Linkfy – On-Device URL Cleaner for iOS

quotes.text:
I built Linkfy, an iOS app that strips tracking junk (utm_*, fbclid, etc.) from URLs.

Runs entirely on-device, no server

Works via share sheet or inside the app

Keeps essential parts of the link intact

I made it because I was tired of sharing messy, tracking-filled links.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-link-cleaner-linkfy/id6749719091

Code (Swift package): https://github.com/zeynep-yildiz/Linkify

Happy to hear feedback and edge cases!
